an11.12:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme,
an11.12:1.2: tena kho pana samayena mahānāmo sakko gilānā vuṭṭhito hoti aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā.
an11.12:1.3: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
an11.12:2.4: atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an11.12:2.8: tesaṃ no bhante nānāvihārehi viharataṃ kenassa vihārena vihātabbanti?
an11.12:3.2: etaṃ kho mahānāma tumhākaṃ patirūpaṃ kulaputtānaṃ yaṃ tumhe tathāgataṃ upasaṅkamitvā puccheyyātha,
an11.12:3.3: ‘tesaṃ no bhante nānāvihārehi viharataṃ kenassa vihārena vihātabba’nti.
an11.12:3.4: saddho kho mahānāma ārādhako hoti no assaddho,
an11.12:3.9: imesu kho tvaṃ mahānāma pañcasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya cha dhamme uttariṃ bhāveyyāsi.
an11.12:4.3: yasmiṃ samaye mahānāma ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussarati, nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
an11.12:4.4: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti tathāgataṃ ārabbha.
an11.12:4.5: ujugatacitto kho pana mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
an11.12:4.6: pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
an11.12:4.7: imaṃ kho tvaṃ mahānāma buddhānussatiṃ gacchantopi bhāveyyāsi, ṭhitopi bhāveyyāsi, nisinnopi bhāveyyāsi, sayānopi bhāveyyāsi, kammantaṃ adiṭṭhahantopi bhāveyyāsi, puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasantopi bhāveyyāsi.
an11.12:5.1: puna caparaṃ tvaṃ mahānāma dhammaṃ anussareyyāsi …pe…
an11.12:5.6: santi devā cātummahārājikā …pe… santi devā tatuttariṃ.
an11.12:5.7: yathārūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā mayhampi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati.
an11.12:5.11: paññāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayhampi tathārūpā paññā saṃvijjatīti.
an11.12:5.12: yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako attano ca tāsañca devatānaṃ saddhañca sīlañca sutañca cāgañca paññañca anussarati, nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an11.12:5.13: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti devatā ārabbha.
an11.12:5.14: ujugatacitto kho pana mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
an11.12:5.15: pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati,
an11.12:5.16: imaṃ kho tvaṃ mahānāma devatānussatiṃ gacchantopi bhāveyyāsi, ṭhitopi bhāveyyāsi, nisinnopi bhāveyyāsi, sayānopi bhāveyyāsi, kammantaṃ adhiṭṭhahantopi bhāveyyāsi, puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasantopi bhāveyyāsīti.
